items.source: context - the evaluation context in which the access is being attempted
items.translation: context - 尝试访问时的评估上下文

items.source: target - the target object upon which the property is being accessed
items.translation: target - 正在访问属性的目标对象

items.source: name - the name of the property being accessed
items.translation: name - 正在访问的属性的名称

items.source: A property accessor can specify an array of target classes for which it should be called. See TargetedAccessor for details.
items.translation: 属性访问器可以指定一个目标类数组，它应针对这些目标类被调用。有关详细信息，请参阅TargetedAccessor。

items.source: Should only succeed if canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, String) also returns true.
items.translation: 应仅在 `canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, String)` 也返回 `true` 时成功。

items.source: Should only succeed if canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, String) also returns true.
items.translation: 应仅在 `canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, String)` 也返回 `true` 时成功。

items.source:
This interface places no restrictions on what constitutes a property.
Implementors are therefore free to access properties directly via fields,
through getters, or in any other way they deem appropriate.
items.translation: 该接口对属性的构成没有限制。因此，实现者可以自由地通过字段直接访问属性、通过 getter 方法，或采用他们认为合适的方式。

items.source:
Called to determine if this property accessor is able to read a specified
property on a specified target object.
items.translation: 调用以确定此属性访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上读取指定的属性。

items.source:
Called to determine if this property accessor is able to write to a specified
property on a specified target object.
items.translation: 调用以确定此属性访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上向指定的属性写入数据。

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem determining whether the property can be read
items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以读取属性时出现任何问题

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem reading the property value
items.translation: AccessException - 如果读取属性值时出现任何问题

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem determining whether the property can be written to
items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以写入该属性时出现任何问题

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem writing to the property value
items.translation: AccessException - 如果向属性值写入时出现任何问题。

items.source: Called to read a property from a specified target object.
items.translation: 被调用以从指定的目标对象读取属性。

items.source: Called to write to a property on a specified target object.
items.translation: 被调用以向指定目标对象的属性写入数据。

items.source: newValue - the new value for the property
items.translation: newValue - 该属性的新值

items.source: Andy Clement
items.translation: 安迪·克莱门特

items.source: true if this property accessor is able to read the property
items.translation: 如果该属性访问器能够读取该属性，则为 true。

items.source:
a TypedValue object wrapping the property value read and a type
descriptor for it
items.translation: 一个封装了读取的属性值的 TypedValue 对象及其类型描述符

items.source: true if this property accessor is able to write to the property
items.translation: 如果此属性访问器能够写入该属性，则为 true。
